privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: We value and protect your personal information

overview.title: Privacy Policy Overview
overview.content: Focus (hereinafter 'Company') values users' personal information and complies with relevant laws including the Personal Information Protection Act and the Act on Promotion of Information and Communications Network Utilization and Information Protection. The company informs users about the purposes and methods for which personal information provided by users is being used, and what measures are being taken to protect personal information through this privacy policy.

section1.title: 1. Purpose of Personal Information Processing
section1.content: The company processes personal information for the following purposes. Personal information being processed will not be used for purposes other than the following, and if the purpose of use changes, necessary measures such as obtaining separate consent will be implemented in accordance with Article 18 of the Personal Information Protection Act.

membership.title: a. Website membership registration and management
membership.description: Personal information is processed for the purposes of confirming membership registration intent, identity verification and authentication for membership services, maintaining and managing membership status, preventing unauthorized service use, confirming consent from legal guardians when processing personal information of children under 14, various notices and notifications, and complaint handling.

service.title: b. Provision of goods or services
service.description: Personal information is processed for the purposes of providing subscription services, content provision, customized service provision, identity verification, age verification, subscription fee payment and settlement, and service usage statistical analysis.

marketing.title: c. Marketing and advertising utilization
marketing.description: Personal information is processed for the purposes of developing new services (products) and providing customized services, providing events and advertising information and participation opportunities, providing services and advertising based on demographic characteristics, confirming service validity, identifying access frequency, or statistics on members' service usage.

section2.title: 2. Items of Personal Information Processed
section2.content: The company processes the following personal information items.

membership.title: a. Membership registration and management
membership.requiredItems: Email address, user's service usage records, access logs, access IP information, cookies, service usage time
membership.optionalItems: Payment information (card numbers, account information, etc. - managed with encryption), profile information

subscription.title: b. Subscription service provision
subscription.requiredItems: Subscription plan information, payment cycle, service usage history, subscription start and end dates

automatic.title: c. Information automatically generated and collected during internet service use
automatic.items: IP address, cookies, MAC address, service usage records, visit records, app usage patterns, focus measurement data, work performance time, etc.

section3.title: 3. Personal Information Processing and Retention Period
section3.content: The company processes and retains personal information within the personal information retention and use period according to law or the personal information retention and use period agreed upon when collecting personal information from data subjects.

membership.title: a. Website membership registration and management
membership.period: Until member withdrawal. However, in the following cases, until the corresponding reason ends
membership.exception1: When investigation or inquiry due to violation of related laws is in progress: until the corresponding investigation or inquiry ends
membership.exception2: When credit-debt relationship remains due to website usage: until the corresponding credit-debt relationship is settled

subscription.title: b. Subscription service provision
subscription.period: Until subscription service usage ends and payment settlement is completed. However, in the following cases, until the corresponding period ends

ecommerce.title: Consumer Protection Act in Electronic Commerce
ecommerce.item1: Records on advertising and display: 6 months
ecommerce.item2: Records on contracts or subscription cancellation, subscription fee payment, service usage: 5 years
ecommerce.item3: Records on consumer complaints or dispute resolution: 3 years

telecom.title: Telecommunications Privacy Protection Act
telecom.item1: Subscriber telecommunications date and time, start/end time, counterpart subscriber number, etc.: 1 year
telecom.item2: Computer communications, internet log record data, access location tracking data: 3 months

additionalInquiries.title: Other Personal Information Violation Report and Consultation Agencies
additionalInquiries.description: If you need to report personal information violations or require consultation from agencies other than our company, please contact the following organizations.
additionalInquiries.agency3: Supreme Prosecutors' Office Cyber Investigation Division (www.spo.go.kr / 1301)

dataDestruction.title: 4. Personal Information Destruction Procedures and Methods
dataDestruction.content: The company destroys personal information without delay when personal information becomes unnecessary due to expiration of retention period, achievement of processing purposes, etc.

procedure.title: a. Destruction Procedures
procedure.description: Information entered by users is transferred to a separate DB (separate documents in case of paper) after achieving the purpose and stored for a certain period according to internal policies and other related laws, then destroyed immediately. Personal information transferred to DB is not used for other purposes unless required by law.

deadline.title: b. Destruction Deadline
deadline.description: User's personal information is destroyed within 5 days from the end date of the retention period when the personal information retention period has expired, and within 5 days from the date when personal information processing is deemed unnecessary due to achievement of personal information processing purposes, service termination, business closure, etc.

method.title: c. Destruction Methods
method.electronic: • Electronic file format information: Complete deletion using technical methods that cannot reproduce records
method.paper: • Personal information printed on paper: Destruction through shredding or incineration

userRights.title: 5. Rights and Duties of Data Subjects and Exercise Methods
userRights.content: Users may exercise the following rights as data subjects.

items.access: Request for access to personal information
items.correction: Request for correction in case of errors

exercise.title: b. Methods of Exercising Rights
exercise.method1: • You may exercise rights against the company in writing, email, fax, etc. according to Article 41, Paragraph 1 of the Personal Information Protection Act Enforcement Decree, and the company will take action without delay.
exercise.method2: • When data subjects request correction or deletion of errors in personal information, the company will not use or provide the relevant personal information until correction or deletion is completed.
exercise.method3: • Rights may be exercised through legal representatives of data subjects or authorized agents.
exercise.method4: • Requests for personal information access and processing suspension may be restricted according to Article 35, Paragraph 4 and Article 37, Paragraph 2 of the Personal Information Protection Act.

thirdParty.title: 6. Third-Party Provision of Personal Information
thirdParty.content: The company does not provide users' personal information to external parties in principle. However, the following cases are exceptions.
thirdParty.exception1: When users have given prior consent
thirdParty.exception2: When required by law or when investigative agencies request according to procedures and methods defined by law for investigation purposes

current.title: Current Third-Party Personal Information Provision Status
current.description: The company is currently not providing users' personal information to third parties.

consignment.title: 7. Personal Information Processing Consignment
consignment.content: The company is currently not consigning personal information processing tasks to external parties. If personal information processing tasks are consigned in the future, we will notify the consignment facts in advance and obtain necessary consent according to relevant laws.

internationalTransfer.title: 8. International Transfer of Personal Information
internationalTransfer.content: The company is currently not transferring users' personal information overseas. If international transfer becomes necessary for service provision in the future, we will notify the transfer facts in advance and obtain necessary consent according to relevant laws.

securityMeasures.title: 9. Personal Information Security Measures
securityMeasures.content: The company takes the following measures to ensure the security of personal information.

administrative.title: a. Administrative Measures
administrative.item1: Establishment and implementation of internal management plans
administrative.item2: Minimization and training of personal information handlers
administrative.item3: Organization and operation of dedicated personal information protection teams

technical.title: b. Technical Measures
technical.item1: Access control management for personal information processing systems
technical.item4: Installation of security programs and regular inspection/updates
technical.item5: Storage and forgery prevention of access records
technical.item6: Use of security devices for document security

physical.title: c. Physical Measures
physical.item1: Access control of computer rooms, data storage rooms, etc.
physical.item3: Locking devices for documents and auxiliary storage media containing personal information

policyChanges.title: 10. Changes to Privacy Policy
policyChanges.content: This privacy policy applies from July 4, 2025, and when there are additions, deletions, and corrections of changes according to laws and policies, we will notify through announcements 7 days before the implementation of changes.

notice.title: Notice Obligation Before Revision
notice.description: When the company revises the privacy policy, it will notify the revision reasons and changes without delay, and the revised content will be posted so that users can check it at any time. However, when there are important changes to users' rights or duties, we will notify at least 30 days in advance.

responsiblePersonDetailed.content: The company designates a privacy protection officer as follows to take overall responsibility for personal information processing and handle data subjects' complaints and damage relief related to personal information processing.
responsiblePersonDetailed.notice: Data subjects may contact the privacy protection officer and relevant departments regarding all personal information protection inquiries, complaint handling, damage relief, etc. that occur while using the company's services (or business). The company will respond and process data subjects' inquiries without delay.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: We'll help solve your questions about Pomocore
faq.description: We've collected common questions about Pomocore. Check detailed answers about security, usage, troubleshooting, and more.

security.question: What data is tracked when the app executes record measurement?
security.answer: Pomocore collects app information, app titles, and URLs for browsers. The collected data is used only for category classification and data visualization purposes, not for any other purposes.

security.question: How does Pomocore protect data?
security.answer: Pomocore uses AES-256 encryption to protect all activity logs. This is one of the strongest encryption standards currently available. Data is stored on servers but is used only for providing services to users and is never used for any other purposes.

security.question: Is there any possibility of my personal information being leaked externally?
security.answer: Absolutely not. Pomocore uses user data only for service provision purposes and never for any other purposes. We do not provide or sell to third parties, and it is not used in any way without user consent.

features.question: Which applications can be tracked?
features.answer: All applications running on macOS can be tracked. This includes various work tools such as VS Code, Xcode, Chrome, Safari, Figma, Sketch, and AI automatically categorizes them.

features.question: How does tracking work when multiple tabs are open simultaneously?
features.answer: Time recording proceeds based on the tab that the user most recently activated.

features.question: How does the leaderboard work?
features.answer: The leaderboard is a feature that allows comparing work time within the same team or group. You can check rankings on Daily, Weekly, and Monthly basis, and category-specific expertise can also be compared. The leaderboard reflects the latest data within 20-30 seconds, allowing real-time ranking changes. All data is processed anonymously.

features.question: Am I tracked even when I'm not doing any activity?
features.answer: No. Pomocore detects AFK (Away From Keyboard) status based on 3 minutes. If there's no activity for 3 minutes, it determines that the user is away and stops log tracking. When activity resumes, tracking automatically restarts.

installation.question: Which macOS versions are supported?
installation.answer: Supports macOS 14.0 (Sonoma) and above. It's optimized for the latest macOS Sequoia and Sonoma, and works smoothly on both Intel Mac and Apple Silicon Mac.

contact.title: Have other questions?
contact.description: If you couldn't find the answer you're looking for in the FAQ, please feel free to contact us anytime.
